@everyone 

Good day Cornucopians! We have officially said goodbye to October and are looking ahead to wrapping up 2022. As usual, I’d like to provide a little update on a few things going on. 


Token Bridge
WOW! Congratulations to everyone on this incredible milestone for our ecosystem. In collaboration with ChainPort, we have successfully opened a token bridge from Binance Smart Chain to Cardano. I might add that this is still active without a security breach, proving that not all bridges are bad. As of writing this announcement, the Corn community has successfully ported over 80 million $COPI tokens to the Cardano ecosystem spread over 800+ ports. From a broader perspective, this is a huge step toward true interoperability as most EVM based blockchains can port some or all of their assets to Cardano, allowing projects to have exposure on multiple blockchains. I can't say enough about how well the ChainPort team has executed on a secure and successful bridge!

New Hires 
Today, we welcomed a Senior 3d Artist to the team. He is an extremely talented individual that will add enormous value across multiple ongoing projects, especially building out large world environments, including land for each sector. We look forward to showcasing some of his work as it comes to fruition. 

We also have a Senior React developer starting in late November that will solely be focused on building out our new website, dashboard, backend admin, and many other things!

Game Development and Art
From a high level, here are a few of the major projects that we are continuing to expand on:
     -  Building out Esperanza - land building, rock systems, foliage, etc
     -  Characters - clothing materials, new hair styles
     -  Sector logistics - details of how sector travel will function, which in turn determines the direction of the artwork. If you have not seen some of the hangar leaks, please check it out in #leaks!
     -  Highway system for player travel
     -  Player accessories
     -  Our racing game is still a high priority for a release in early 2023

New Website/Dashboard Tools
We are currently in the process of laying out our new website! This has obviously been something we have needed and we are very excited to get this project moving toward completion. 

To sign off, here are a few Joshua Trees being worked on for Esperanza! How bout' them apples?!

We are happy to announce we have joined the Cardano index in partnership with Blueshift, a cross chain DEX built on Milkomeda- powered by Cardano.

 Through the Cardano Index, we now have visibility into other chains, which is an important part of our project development plan.

 Learn more about the Cardano Index: https://medium.com/liquifiorg/the-cardano-index-is-launched-on-the-blueshift-dex-5f61c27e5e3e
